Class colours (scarlet and white) are a single class's, not the school's.
evidence: archive.org 1956 Watsontown HS yearbook ('The Warrior') OCR: 'On a mud-covered field at Mifflinburg, the Orange and Blue easily defeated...', 'the Huskies suffered their second loss'; 'The Orange and Blue is the school news magazine'. Cover scan: faded orange/peach cloth (~#F2B88A). 1958 yearbook OCR also lists 'Orange and Blue Staff'.

era: Closed (brackets 1961-1973); per an alumni group the school was later renamed Maplewood (PENNCREST SD). Colours below are Townville's own.
notes: Blue and Gold from the 1951 school song; the 1964 yearbook cover (navy design on gold cloth) agrees. Blue hex is the navy ink of the 1964 cover scan; the gold cloth is faded/pale in the scan, so no gold hex. Mascot Eagles from 1964 yearbook sports text.
evidence: Townville HS 'Memories' 1951 yearbook text (e-yearbook OCR): school song 'The Gold and the Blue ... We will fight on Gold and Blue'. archive.org 1964 'Memories' yearbook cover scan: navy #26324A diamond/spire design on pale gold cloth (~#F0D88C, faded); 1964 sports pages call the teams 'the Eagles'. e-yearbook cover images now return 410 Gone.

notes: Gold is certain. Official school colours were gold and white (Wikipedia infobox; the alumni group's 'Gold and White Grants'); athletics used black and gold (MaxPreps, PIAA football table, alumni logo). Gold hex is from the alumni group's logo (post-closure), not a school-era logo.
evidence: Friends of Bishop McDevitt (alumni group) Google Site: logo is a gold #FFD800 block 'M' and gold ring on black #000000; site names its fund 'Gold and White Grants'. Wikipedia infobox: Gold and White. MaxPreps (403 now; snippet): Black, Gold.

identified_as: Waynesburg High School, Waynesburg (predecessor of Waynesburg Central)
era: Waynesburg HS predates Waynesburg Central HS (Central Greene SD), which opened in 1969 (Raiders, red and black). Bracket years 1951-68 are the old Waynesburg HS.
notes: Red and black are Waynesburg Central's colours; not verified for the pre-1969 Waynesburg HS. The Raiders nickname did exist at Waynesburg HS by 1952, and the 1952 yearbook cover is maroon/dark red, which fits red but is not a colour statement.
evidence: Central Greene SD (cgsd.org) Raider head logo: red #DE0F0F and black (successor school, so no hex given). archive.org 1952 Waynesburg HS yearbook 'Oracle' OCR: basketball write-ups call the team 'the Raiders'; cover is maroon cloth (~#661F12, aged). No colour statement in the OCR.

identified_as: Delhaas High School, Bristol Township (Bucks Co.)
era: Bristol Township's first high school (opened c. 1951, in the Lower Bucks County League from 1953); closed after the 1980 season when Delhaas and Woodrow Wilson were replaced by Harry S Truman HS (1981).
notes: Inference: nickname Tigers is certain (1974 yearbook); colours inferred from the 1974 yearbook cover (crimson and old-gold cloth) and the band's 'Crimson Girl' feature twirler. No explicit colour statement found. Cover cloth is aged, so no hex.
evidence: archive.org 1974 Delhaas HS yearbook 'Images 74': cover is crimson (~#7F2A1C, aged) and olive-gold (~#817441) cloth; OCR text: 'Tiger Wrestling', 'Delhaas Tiger Marching Band', 'CRIMSON GIRL—L. Monico' in the band section. lowerbuckssource.net article refused (Not Acceptable).
